description:
Make the guard on gate-registry changes compare through the git module in the selected worktree, instead of probing and comparing in the process working directory.

## Background

- `enforce_main_only_operations` in `commands/worktree.rs` takes an optional repository layout and probes/comparisons run at its selected data root. Ordinary `JIT_DATA_DIR` selection already works; an external data root is not the selected checkout. The current code has no test-mode bypass.
- Gate-registry operations in `commands/gate.rs` call the free guard through their real repository layout; migrate every current caller to the canonical method.
- The formerly empty guard unit tests are already absent. The selected-repository CLI property has an existing owner in `worktree_cli_tests.rs`; extend that scenario rather than duplicating it.
- The module's base comparison returns `Compared`, `BaseUnresolved` or `NoMergeBase`.
- The two free functions become one executor method in the same change; keeping them beside it would leave two guard implementations (`@/inv/convention-convergence`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The guard is an executor method comparing through the module's base comparison of the executor's paths with base `origin/main`. It refuses only on a `Compared` outcome whose merge base differs from the base's commit, with today's message; without a git checkout, on `BaseUnresolved` and on `NoMergeBase` it allows the operation as today.
- [hard] REQ-02: `check_branch_divergence`, `enforce_main_only_operations` no longer exist, and neither `commands/worktree.rs` nor `commands/gate.rs` starts a git process for the guard.
- [hard] REQ-03: A CLI test runs `jit gate define` from a repository that matches its `origin/main`, with `JIT_DATA_DIR` selecting a repository whose branch diverged, and asserts the guard's refusal. Preserve this ordinary selected-repository behavior at its existing test owner; the current implementation already selects the data root.

## Notes

- Whether the guard runs at all, and against which remote branch, is decided outside this change.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Main-history guard runs against the selected worktree
